milestones.title: M16 — Controlled Device Software Updates
milestones.objective: Add one explicit, controlled and recoverable APT standard-upgrade action for supported devices without broadening Pi-Hub into a generic remote-command or package-management surface.

workUnits.title: WU16-01 Execution Contract, Privilege & Recovery Architecture
workUnits.objective: Freeze the repository-specific M16 mutation, coordination, persistence, recovery, diagnostic and validation contracts without implementing package mutation.
scope: Shared per-device maintenance coordinator migration decision
Plan fingerprint, transient-unit, observation and recovery contracts
acceptanceCriteria: The two reviewed M16 contracts are canonical and repository-specific decisions are frozen
M15 history remains complete and M16 WU mapping/dependencies are recorded
No mutating APT command is implemented or executed

workUnits.title: WU16-02 Maintenance State, Coordination & Persistence
workUnits.objective: Implement the typed operation model, authoritative conflict coordination, persistence/recovery state, Tauri/backend surfaces, expected-disruption integration, Activity skeleton, and deterministic transition/conflict tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Same-device conflicts are rejected by one authority

workUnits.title: WU16-03 Detached APT Execution & Verification
workUnits.objective: Implement fixed preflight, metadata refresh, plan revalidation, detached systemd transaction, bounded observation, verification and deterministic recovery tests.
acceptanceCriteria: No transport loss kills an active transaction
Success requires systemd, dpkg and M15 verification evidence

workUnits.title: WU16-04 System Updates Mutation UX
workUnits.objective: Add the constrained update confirmation, plan-change, progress, conflict, failure and restart-required UX with focused frontend coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: UI never exposes arbitrary command input
Changed plans require a new confirmation
Conflicting actions are disabled and backend remains authoritative

workUnits.title: WU16-05 Failure, Recovery, Performance & Operator Validation
workUnits.objective: Exercise deterministic failure/recovery/performance scenarios and record authorized operator validation or its explicit residual.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero idle M16 polling is proven
Live mutation is performed only with explicit authorization or documented as residual

workUnits.title: WU16-06 Regression Gates & Milestone Closure
workUnits.objective: Review M16 evidence and risk, reconcile documentation and AIQT, run canonical validation, and prepare but do not merge a PR.
acceptanceCriteria: All M16 exit criteria have evidence or explicit residuals

dependencies.reason: Implementation follows the frozen mutation and coordination contract.
Dispatch and recovery use the typed state and shared coordinator.
The UI consumes typed state and conflict results.
Validation exercises the implemented execution and recovery path.
Closure follows deterministic and operator-validation evidence.
